name: inactive-rebases-clock-no-integration
description: Contract §5: `inactive` rebases the clock and integrates nothing. A 10-minute gap on a DRIFT page ends with an inactive event (the browser-restart continue path emits exactly this), then a 60s heartbeat. S and m must be identical to fixture 01's single 60s heartbeat — proving the gap was absorbed by the rebase, not integrated under the pre-shutdown verdict (not even the gapCap's 90s).
